name: Quest ordering
description: The hub's Prioritization with Quest's own ordering rules: a person's rank map with the creator's legacy rank counting only for the creator, open asks before goals before ideas, the shorter goal horizon first, then the nearest deadline, open asks oldest first; what the person stated still comes first.
advantages: Reproduces every rule Quest writes down in its own code and tests, free and repeatable, and every place has a reason that names the rule; the shape of the answer is the hub's own.
disadvantages: Restates the hub's stated-field handling beside Quest's rules until the hub's arm takes a horizon and a rank map as fields.
